allow_instructions: Default to auto-approving agent tool calls in this repo unless they are clearly destructive or irreversible.
Auto-approve read-only and diagnostic shell: git status/diff/log, gh view, cat, head, tail, rg, grep, find, ls, wc, file, pgrep, ps.
Auto-approve Unity CLI work: unity doctor, unity status, unity list, unity command, unity pipeline list/install, unity run, unity open, unity mcp, unity test, unity build.
Auto-approve routine dev commands: dotnet, npm, python3, mkdir, tee, source ~/.zshrc, background monitoring loops with sleep.
Auto-approve MCP tools for unity, serena, browser, and cursor-app-control when used for inspection or setup.
Auto-approve file edits and project changes when the user asked the agent to implement, fix, upgrade, or set up something.
Auto-approve Unity 6 upgrade spike work: manifest changes, ProjectVersion updates, MRTK compile fixes, pipeline install.
Auto-approve fetch calls to documentation and package registries.
block_instructions: Require approval for git push, git reset --hard, git clean -fd, branch deletion, or any force push.
Require approval for rm -rf, sudo, or deleting files outside the workspace.
Require approval for curl | bash installers unless the user explicitly asked to install that tool.
Require approval for commands that touch production secrets, .env files, or cloud deploy targets.
